items.t: Camshaft position sensor can melt and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor and add fuse
items.note: Daewoo's US dealers closed, so a shop may charge for this. RepairPal puts the same sensor job on the related Chevrolet Aveo at about $255-$358.

items.t: Timing belt breaks and bends valves
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner, idlers and water pump
items.note: Based on the related Suzuki Forenza 2.0L, which RepairPal puts at about $1,500-$1,600. If the valves are bent, owners paid about $1,400-$2,250.

items.t: Front lower control arm bushings wear out
items.job: Replace front lower control arms and align
items.note: Based on the related Chevrolet Aveo. Bushings alone cost less; alignment is extra.

items.t: Front brake hoses can crack and leak (recall)
items.note: If the recall can't be done, RepairPal puts a brake hose job on the related Chevrolet Aveo at about $115-$161 per hose.

items.t: Brake pedal sinks toward the floor
items.job: Repair brake leak or replace master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: A hose is at the low end; a master cylinder is at the high end.

items.job: Read codes and replace faulty sensor

items.t: Engine stalls at low speed or idle
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace failed sensor or fuel part

items.t: Automatic transmission fails or won't move
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a used or rebuilt unit
items.note: Used transmissions for this car are scarce; ask about a rebuild.

items.t: Brake rotors warp and pads wear fast
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: RepairPal puts pads alone on the related Suzuki Forenza at about $196-$253.

items.job: Replace valve cover gasket or front oil seals
items.note: A valve cover gasket is the low end. Seals behind the timing belt cost more because the belt comes off.
Based on the related Suzuki Forenza 2.0L, which RepairPal puts at about $2,200-$3,050.

items.t: Starts and dies, or cranks with no spark
items.job: Test and replace crankshaft position sensor
items.note: Price is for a sensor; an anti-theft fault may need a key or module.

items.t: Brake lights fail and shifter sticks in Park
Water leaks onto the passenger floor
items.job: Clear A/C drain hose and reseal cowl
Diagnose engine noise and replace tensioner or idler
